owner_notes: W-11 is done. Measured from the NG captures already on disk: NG's party walls, house pairing, junctions, detours, blocks, courtyards and gaps along the street front. Nothing touched any website, and nothing went into plat/.

Found and fixed: NG draws roads and buildings on separate layers and never records how they line up. In 7 of the 8 maps the two layers were up to about 38 pixels apart, so roads appeared to run through houses. Each layer is now aligned against the map's own screenshot, and after that 0 or 1 houses touch a road line per map. The 44 new NG recordings (W-04) must keep their screenshots for the same reason.

A Fable seat needs to rule on: the 0.35 m per model unit conversion for NG's metre-based numbers; which reading of 'pairing' counts (42-46 % or 9-13 %); whether NG's crossroads share is 0 (as recorded) or up to 5 % (when T-junctions 2 m apart are merged); the street-gap definition; and the blocks at the hood's undrawn edge. All values are on two recorded seeds, so baseline rows wait for W-04's seeds or a ruling.

Three design numbers in section 13.5 were stated under older definitions and shift under the catalogue's. Party walls go from 39-43 % to 42-46 % (now a median per house), attached houses from 95-99 % to 98-100 %, and Moran's I from -0.04..+0.03 to -0.18..+0.05.
notes: rows = 14 metric ids with per-seed fixture values per template (bldg.pairing, bldg.partyShare, bldg.attached, plot.moran, plot.minWidth, junction.angles, junction.share4, street.detour, street.cyclesPerKm2, fg.streetwallGap100, block.countTemplate, block.area as block.areaRel, block.courtShare, time.model as fixtures only); 0 crossing-ready rows: PC-04 (recorded seeds 7171/7172 fail C7), PC-03 (metre metrics on a declared 0.35 m/mu), PC-11 (no 12.1 ratio for time).

Pooled values (8 maps, medium): partyShare median 0.419-0.464; attached 0.978-0.996; pairing B 0.403-0.464 (A 0.088-0.132, mutual 0.169-0.225); Moran (shared edge) -0.183..+0.053; junction angles median 90.8-92.9, p5 86.0-88.5; share4 raw 0 in every map, merged 0-0.053; detour 1.23-1.32; built blocks 76/59, 44/40, 17/18, 7/11; court share 115/268 deep blocks = 0.43; gaps > 2 m per 100 m 2.25-3.15 (declared); plot.minWidth p50 7.1-7.3 m declared.

Junction census: every degree-3 junction in all 8 maps is a street ending on another road (186, 156, 121, 101, 57, 54, 31, 41); 0 raw degree-4 nodes, so §13.5's 361/361 T reading holds; 4-ways appear only from the declared 2 m merge.
Bent footprint vertices (interior 170-190 deg) lie on party walls in only 1-8 % of cases: NG's bent edges are fronts and rears, not party walls (CONFIDENCE §6 #10, README-vertices headline 4).

Frontage band set to 1.0 x the median footprint short side after measuring setbacks (p90 0.52-0.60, row back edge ~1.7); 0.5 sat inside the setback spread and gave a fragile count; 0.75/1.0/1.25 now agree within 0.12 per 100 m.
36 % of footprints (2 120 of 5 861) lie in no bounded face because the hood edge is not drawn; block counts are interior counts (ruling owed).
